paragraphs.en: To S.L.O., an American gentleman with a classic taste for sailor tales, this narrative is dedicated in return for delightful hours spent together. The author, with kind wishes, dedicates it to him.
paragraphs.zh: 献给S.L.O.这位拥有经典 sailors 味道的美国绅士，在与他共度的美好时光中，这段叙述作为回报而献给他。作者怀着善良的愿望向他表示敬意。

paragraphs.en: For those who enjoy sailor stories set to sea tunes, full of storm and adventure, heat and cold, this tale of schooners, islands, maroons, buccaneers, and buried gold retold in the ancient way may please today's wiser youngsters as much as before.
paragraphs.zh: 对于喜欢听海员故事并配上海歌的读者来说，充满风暴与冒险、炎热与寒冷的故事，这种以古风重述的关于快帆船、岛屿、流放者、海盗和埋藏宝藏的故事，或许会像过去一样，让今天的智龄青年们感到愉悦。

paragraphs.en: If not, if studious youth no longer crave such tales, let it be so! The author hopes that even without them, he and all his pirates will share a peaceful grave with their creations.
paragraphs.zh: 如果不再有这样的情节吸引求知的年轻人，那就随它去吧！作者希望即便没有这些故事，他和他的海盗们也能与他们创造的角色一同安息于宁静的地下。
